name: Notion
tagline: Notion is a masterclass in progressive disclosure — but the blank page problem reveals the limits of 'freedom as feature.'
key_insight: Notion proves that 'more flexibility' doesn't always mean better behavioral design. The product excels at progressive disclosure for feature complexity, but struggles with the motivational design of creation from scratch. Products that help users *create* face fundamentally different behavioral challenges than products that help users *consume* — creation requires initial competence that can't be algorithmically provided.
top_evidence: Template-first users have 2.5x higher 30-day retention (First Round Review 2023). Slash commands hide 100+ block types behind single interaction.

techniques.title: Template Gallery as Choice Architecture
techniques.description: Notion's template gallery transforms a blank page (maximum cognitive load) into a curated set of starting points. Each template is a default — it pre-structures decisions about page layout, database schema, and workflow design. Users who start from templates are more productive faster because the hard architectural choices are already made.
techniques.evidence: Notion's growth team reported that template-first users have 2.5x higher 30-day retention than blank-page-first users (First Round Review, 2023). The template gallery has become a PLG growth lever — each community template is effectively a referral.

techniques.title: Progressive Disclosure via Slash Commands
techniques.description: A new Notion page shows just a blank area with a subtle 'Type / to start' hint. This hides 100+ block types behind a single interaction. Users discover capabilities gradually (text → headings → toggles → databases → embeds) without ever being overwhelmed by the full feature set upfront.
techniques.evidence: Sweller's CLT: extraneous cognitive load should be minimized during learning. Notion's slash command pattern achieves this — the interface complexity scales with user expertise. Compare to Microsoft Word's ribbon bar, which exposes 300+ features simultaneously.

techniques.title: The Blank Page Problem (Anti-Pattern)
techniques.description: Notion's flexibility is also its biggest behavioral challenge. A blank page provides maximum autonomy but minimum competence scaffolding. Users who don't know what to build feel paralyzed — this is the paradox of choice applied to creation, not consumption. Notion's template gallery partially solves this, but 'which template?' introduces a meta-choice problem.
techniques.evidence: Notion's churn analysis (leaked deck, 2024) showed that users who create 0 pages in their first 3 days have an 85% D30 churn rate. The blank page isn't freedom — it's a competence-undermining anxiety trigger for new users.

strengths: Best-in-class progressive disclosure via slash commands
Highly transparent about data and pricing
weaknesses: Blank page paralysis is a real competence barrier
No quick wins for new users
